_comment: Site-crawl seeds for SRE AI / LLM ops docs. DeepSeek Flash screens by scope hint.

_schema.url: Seed page or section root URL
_schema.scope: Hint for Flash screener — what to keep / skip
_schema.source_type: blog-post | documentation | discussion | paper | practitioner-repo | failure-report
_schema.max_per_run: (optional) default 3 — max new URLs to screen/file per seed per run

seeds.scope: SRE practice chapters relevant to automation, toil, incident response — skip pure culture essays without technical practice. Skip any URL containing /table-of-contents, /index, or with no path segment after /workbook/. Only follow chapter URLs of the form /workbook/chapter-name/.
observability, telemetry pipelines, AI/LLM instrumentation — skip marketing and conference CFPs
cloud-native reliability, platform engineering, AI ops — skip event promotions
LLM tracing, evals, token/cost monitoring, production agent observability — skip general Datadog product setup unrelated to LLM ops
LLM observability, tracing, evals, prompt/version management for production agents — skip pricing, careers, and pure marketing pages
LLM gateway/proxy: routing, rate limits, spend, fallbacks, production deploy — skip marketing and pricing
Eval harnesses, CI gating, red-team/regression for LLM apps — skip pure product marketing
